args.summary: Latest deploy v2.3.1 failed health checks in production. Rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) from v2.3.1 to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback completed and verified. v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until the health check failures are root-caused and fixed.
args.title: checkout-api: rollback from v2.3.1 to v2.3.0 after failed health checks

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what was completed:

1. **Investigated:** Deployment history for `checkout-api` showed v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was unhealthy in production, and v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release (v2.3.1-rc was only ever unhealthy in staging).

2. **Rolled back:** `checkout-api` rolled back from v2.3.1 to **v2.3.0** across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) — rollout completed and verified.

3. **Opened incident:** SEV2 incident **INC-0001** is open and the on-call engineer has been paged, documenting the failed health checks and the rollback action.
